heroNudge.title: Hero Nudge Setup
heroNudge.instructions: Record in a soft whisper to help your hero transition to a lighter sleep stage.
heroNudge.line1: Shhh... you're doing so well tonight.
heroNudge.line2: You are a real Hero, sleeping so deeply and comfortably.
heroNudge.line3: Everything is safe and warm. Let's keep the bed nice and dry and cozy, just like it is right now.
heroNudge.line4: I'm so proud of you for being a Hero.
heroNudge.line5: Sweet dreams... I'll see you in the morning.
